ground_truth.title: VERTE LUMBAR SUPPORT CHAIR: ADJUSTABLE BACK W/HEADREST:
ground_truth.main_content:
What makes The Verte Chair unique and a superior value compared to other office chairs is:
The Verte Chair has custom chair features of 11-torsion spring-loaded vertebrae that take an exact impression of your spine as you move, for comfort that goes all the way to the bone. The back of the lumbar chair support is also lockable. And you can adjust each of the 11 vertebrae individually and lock them.

Very popular as a radiology chair among radiologists. And it was featured in the movie

Batman vs Superman and is known as the Batman Chair.

 These are the reasons we say the Verte Chair is the best ergonomic chair. Ergonomic Home has your back!

We have been selling the RFM Seating #22405 Verte Chair since it was introduced into production in September 2004. Longer than any other Internet retailer. We are a registered RFM factory dealer since 2004. I personally have been using it since then for my lower back problems due to sports injuries. Standard Features:

Executive Back w/Adjustable Headrest:
 Advanced synchro tilt 05-control w/built-in seat slider, tilt lock and silver base/ribs.

Back Angle Adjustment.
 While seated, pull the paddle up, when the desired angle is found push the paddle down to lock. Back Free floats in the paddle-up position.

Pneumatic Height Adjustment.
 To lower, lift the paddle while seated. To raise, lift the paddle with your weight off the seat.

Infinite Seat Angle.
 Adjust with 3 Degree Forward Tilt to change the seat angle, pull the paddle up while seated, and push the paddle down to lock when the desired angle is achieved. The seat can be set in free motion within the 3-degree travel range.

SynchroTilt/Lock.
 Turn the knob clockwise to lock backrest in position. To unlock, turn the knob counterclockwise and lean back on the chair to release the anti- kickback mechanism.

Adjustable headrest
 is standard.

Standard dual-density
 seat foam 4" thick easily supports 300 lbs.

Added benefit of the Verte chair
 is the quick release back upholstery. Snap off to experience the cool metal vertebrae and keep cool. Keeps you cool like a mesh office chair. You also will experience a more pronounced action of the 11 independently adjustable vertebrae. You can quickly re-attach the back upholstery with four snaps.

Dimensions:
 back width=20.5", seat width=21.5", seat depth=20.5", back height=23.5" not including the headrest that adjusts 10" in height.

Arms:
 Fold Down Arm #01A, Adjustable 4 Way Arm #37A, Swing Arm #04A

Warranty:
 Lifetime warranty on cylinder, 7 years on all other parts.

Optional Features:

Optional Memory foam:
 Above right - for even greater comfort. You will have a total of 3 3/4" of foam composed of 2.25" of firm-density foam in the bottom layer, then 1.25" of memory foam on top. What memory foam does is once the heat of your body warms up the memory foam, it conforms to your specific shape better than cellular foam. After you get up the foam returns to its original shape. So basically you get a custom fit every time you sit in your Verte ergonomic chair. The memory foam chair seat option relieves pressure on your tailbone too. Select above right.

New Upholstery Options:
